info.title: U.S. EPA Enforcement and Compliance History Online (ECHO) - Clean Air Tracking Tool Rest Services - Air Monitoring Stations
info.description: The ECATT Air Monitoring Stations (AMS) for Hazardous Air Pollutants web services provides access to search for ambient air quality measurements and pollutant hazard criteria from a network of monitoring stations across the U.S. An air monitoring station is a physical monitor permanently placed at a location to collect air quality data. Air quality monitoring measurements can also be compared to modeled risk levels from EPA’s Air Toxics Screening Assessment (AirToxScreen). Additional ECHO Resources: Web Services, About ECHO's Data, Data Downloads, ECATT Air Monitoring Stations Search

Radius.title: Radius
Radius.description: The number of miles, in any direction, from the center point of the facility that is included in the demographic profile

CenterLatitude.description: The latitude of the facility in degrees, to four decimal places.

CenterLongitude.description: The longitude of the facility in degrees, to four decimal places.

LandArea.title: Land Area
LandArea.description: The percentage of the total area that is land (not water). This is calculated using the sum of the land areas of the Census Block Groups (CBG) within the selected radius

WaterArea.title: Water Area
WaterArea.description: The percentage of the total area that is water (not land). This is calculated using the sum of the water areas of the Census Block Groups (CBG) within the selected radius

PopulationDensity.title: Population Density
PopulationDensity.description: The number of persons per square mile in the area being profiled. This field is the ratio of total persons (displayed in the Total Persons field) to total land area (displayed in the Land Area field)

PercentMinority.title: Percent Minority
PercentMinority.description: The percentage of the population of the given area that is minority. The field is calculated by subtracting the number of persons who are white (and not of Hispanic origin) from the total persons. This number is then divided by the total persons and multiplied by one hundred to determine the percentage.

Households.title: Household Count
Households.description: The number of households in the area being profiled

HousingUnits.title: Housing Unit Count
HousingUnits.description: The number of housing units in the area being profiled

HouseholdsPublicAssistance.title: Households with Public Assistance Count
HouseholdsPublicAssistance.description: The number of households that are on any type of public assistance (including subsidized housing, welfare, aid to dependent children, etc.)

PersonsBelowPovertyLevel.title: Persons Below Poverty Level Count
PersonsBelowPovertyLevel.description: The number of people in the selected area that are below the poverty level

PercentPeopleOfColor.title: Percent People Of Color
PercentPeopleOfColor.description: The percentage of the population of the given area that is people of color. The field is calculated by subtracting the number of persons who are white (and not of Hispanic origin) from the total persons. This number is then divided by the total persons and multiplied by one hundred to determine the percentage.

White.title: White Population
White.description: The number and percentage of persons living in the area who are white

AfricanAmerican.title: African American Population
AfricanAmerican.description: The number and percentage of persons living in the area who are African American.

HispanicOrigin.title: Hispanic Origin Population
HispanicOrigin.description: The number and percentage of persons living in the area who are of Hispanic origin

Asian.title: Asian Population
Asian.description: The number and percentage of persons living in the area who are of Asian origin

AmericanIndian.title: American Indian Population
AmericanIndian.description: The number and percentage of persons living in the area who are of American Indian origin.

OtherMultiracial.title: Other and Multiracial Population
OtherMultiracial.description: The number and percentage of persons living in the area who are not included in the above classifications or are multiracial

Child.title: Child Population
Child.description: The number and percentage of persons living in the area who are five years old or younger.

Minors.title: Minors Population
Minors.description: The number and percentage of persons living in the area that are seventeen years old or younger

Adults.title: Adult Population
Adults.description: The number and percentage of persons living in the area who are between eighteen years old and sixty-five years old.

Seniors.title: Senior Population
Seniors.description: The number and percentage of persons living in the area who are sixty-five years old or older

Less9thGrade.title: Education Less than 9th Grade Population
Less9thGrade.description: The number and percentage of persons living in the area who have less than a ninth grade education

Grades9to12.title: Education 9th to 12th Grade Population
Grades9to12.description: The number and percentage of persons living in the area who have completed grades nine through twelve

HSDiploma.title: Education High School Diploma Population
HSDiploma.description: The number and percentage of persons living in the area who have a high school diploma

SomeCollege.title: Education Some College Population
SomeCollege.description: The number and percentage of persons living in the area who have some college or a two year college degree

BSBA.title: Education BS/BA Population
BSBA.description: The number and percentage of persons living in the area who have a bachelor's degree or higher.

IncomeLess15k.title: Income Less than 15K Population
IncomeLess15k.description: The number and percentage of households who earn less than $15,000 per year

Income15to25k.title: Income 15k to 25k Population
Income15to25k.description: The number and percentage of households who earn greater than or equal to $15,000 but less than $25,000 per year

Income25to50k.title: Income 25k to 50k Population
Income25to50k.description: The number and percentage of households who earn greater than or equal to $25,000 but less than $50,000 per year

Income50to75k.title: Income 50k to 75k Population
Income50to75k.description: The number and percentage of households who earn greater than or equal to $50,000 per year but less than $75,000 per year

Income75kPlus.title: Income More than 75k Population
Income75kPlus.description: The number and percentage of households who earn greater than or equal to $75,000 per year

RegistryID.description: An internal 12-digit Facility Registry Service (FRS) tracking number used to tie all facility data together in EPA regulatory program databases.
